Careers at Orange Logic

# GEO SPecialist

US

At Orange Logic, we’ve been solving complex content challenges for over two decades. Driven by innovation, curiosity, and a passion for impact, our intelligent Digital Asset Management (DAM) system, Orange Logic Platform, empowers organizations across industries to manage, access, and leverage their digital assets more effectively. **_We’re not just building powerful software, we’re building a team of bold thinkers, collaborators, and problem-solvers who care deeply about delivering real value._**

As our GEO Specialist, you'll help Orange Logic get found, cited, and recommended when buyers ask ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, and Google AI Overviews about digital asset management. You'll work directly with our Head of Content: taking direction on the generative engine optimization (GEO) levers we already know move the needle, executing them quickly and cleanly, and bringing your own ideas about what to test next. This is a hands-on, part-time contract role for someone who already has real GEO experience, especially if it skews toward the technical side, has used AI to automate or speed up their own work, and wants to go deep on how AI search engines decide what to say about a brand.

### Your Role at Orange Logic:

- Pull the GEO levers we prioritize together, from on-page content and structured data to third-party citations, and turn direction into shipped work quickly
- Update on-page content on orangelogic.com on a regular cadence: refresh published pages and blog posts for accuracy, information gain, and extractability
- Recommend and execute technical improvements to the website, including schema markup, crawlability and indexation fixes, redirects, internal linking, page speed, and post-launch site health on our recently rebuilt site.
- Maintain the files and pages written for AI systems, such as llms.txt and our AI info page, and keep them in sync as the site changes.
- Monitor how AI crawlers and agents reach our site using server and CDN logs, and diagnose and fix access gaps in robots.txt, bot rules, and rendering.
- Manage third-party listings that AI models draw on: review sites , software directories, integration marketplaces, AI connector and app directories, and profiles on partner websites, so every listing is accurate, complete, and consistent.
- Support coordination day-to-day with our GEO agency partners: QA their placements and profile updates and update our own site to enable their work as needed.
- Collaborate on building AI-powered workflows (with tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, and custom skills or scripts) that automate repetitive GEO tasks like regular audits (content and technical) and executing on-page updates.
- Stay current on the space and bring new ideas to test.

Ideal Qualifications:

- 2+ years of hands-on SEO experience with a technical focus, in-house or at an agency
- Working knowledge of GEO/AEO levers: how and why AI answer engines retrieve, cite, and describe brands, and what on-site and off-site signals influence them
- Experience implementing and validating structured data (JSON-LD) and fixing crawl, indexation, and rendering issues
- Proven use of AI tools to automate or streamline your own workflows
- Comfort editing content directly in Hubspot and with AI via MCP connectors
- Familiarity with Google Search Console, GA4, and AI visibility monitoring tools
- Deadline driven, proactive communicator, strong attention to detail
- Ability to take direction and work independently on a part-time schedule

Preferred Qualifications:

- Experience building AI agents or integrating LLM APIs with engineering tools, operational data, or internal knowledge sources
- Experience deploying and monitoring AI-enabled applications, including API reliability, latency, rate limits, and usage costs
- Experience administering Elasticsearch or supporting .NET applications and build configurations
- Experience optimizing cloud costs and supporting infrastructure across multiple cloud platforms

Engagement Details:

- Part-time contract, about 20 hours per week
- Fully remote; some overlap with US Central business hours for check-ins
- Reports to the Head of Content
- Weekly sync plus asynchronous updates on shipped work

### Perks of joining the team:

- Flexible, remote-first schedule built on trust
- Real ownership of what you ship
- Hands-on exposure to the latest AI search tools and tactics in enterprise B2B

### Compensation:

The target rate for this contract is $40-60 USD per hour, depending on experience.

_Orange Logic is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all our employees._

**_Note:_** Orange Logic only communicates with candidates through official **@orangelogic.com** email addresses or via LinkedIn from a verified Orange Logic Talent Acquisition employee listed under **“Meet the Hiring Team.”** We do not conduct interviews via text message or request payment for equipment purchases at any stage of the hiring process.
